notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasure tokens, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
